result.summary: The home feed has visible horizontal overflow and a missing restaurant image, with lower content partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge: the third card is cut off and an additional category pill is partially visible, making the screen feel wider than the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Constrain horizontal lists to the viewport and use intentional carousel padding/peek behavior so clipped items do not appear accidentally truncated.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken-image placeholder icon instead of its restaurant image.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/loading state and provide a polished fallback image or skeleton when an image cannot be loaded.

issues.description: The next popular restaurant card is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving its image only partially visible at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding for the fixed navigation bar so feed cards can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: The promotional text uses inconsistent spacing around the currency amount: "min. order €10".
issues.suggestion: Use consistent localized currency formatting, for example "min. order €10" only if that matches the product style everywhere, or standardize it across the app.
